collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: Everyone expected a villager to be a builder, but they love fishing: say you're happy fishing, or say you don't know yet.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Everyone always expected (subject) to be a builder. (subject.He/she) is strong, careful, good with tools. When (subject.he/she) was young, people used to say, "You'll be the best builder this village has ever had." Lately (subject) has been spending every spare moment out on the water, fishing, and loving it. Today (elder), an elder, says, "When are you going back to building?"

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "I don't know," says (subject). "I like the water. I liked building too. Maybe both." (elder) grumbles that you can't do both. (subject) shrugs. (subject.He/she) spends the morning fixing a roof and the afternoon fishing, and is not entirely sure which part (subject.he/she) liked better. (subject.He/she) doesn't need to know yet.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "I'm not, I think," says (subject). (elder) looks surprised, then a little disappointed. (subject) waits to feel guilty. It doesn't come. (subject.He/she) goes fishing that afternoon and catches nothing, and is perfectly happy. (elder), a few days later, asks how the fishing is going. That's something.
